apps.name: YTKACE
apps.subtitle: Open-source YouTube enhancements for iOS.
apps.localizedDescription: Official YTKACE release IPAs for standalone installation with SideStore and older-version access from LiveContainer.

versions.localizedDescription:
YTKACE 0.9.2

What’s new:
• Updated for YouTube 21.35.3
• Added a save button to community post images, saved at full resolution
• Added Posts to the tab bar, so it can be shown as a tab or set as the startup tab
• Added a choice of where downloads are saved, between the YTKACE library, Photos, or asking each time
• Added a custom hold speed with a slider from 0.25x to 5x, and the speed pill now shows the speed you set
• Added a toggle to remove the ⋯ button from the action bar
• Added a toggle to remove the row of buttons under the progress bar in fullscreen
• Added a toggle to limit gestures to landscape only

Fixed:
• Fixed the app freezing while saving large videos to Photos
• Fixed tapping an image in the comments opening the share sheet
• Fixed a crash when rotating the player
• Fixed a crash when leaving the app while a message was on screen

YouTube 21.35.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_0.9.2_YouTube_21.35.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_0.9.2_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 0.9.1

What’s new:
• Updated for YouTube 21.34.3
• Added a default startup tab option, so YouTube can open on any tab you choose
• Added a Shorts session limit that stops endless scrolling after a set number

Fixed:
• Fixed Save to Photos silently doing nothing, and it now confirms when a video is saved
• Fixed Save to Photos on large videos, and it now explains when Photos cannot store the format
• Fixed backing up settings producing an empty file with nothing in it
• Reduced feed scrolling lag from Remove Products, Shorts, Mixes and Community Posts

YouTube 21.34.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_0.9.1_YouTube_21.34.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_0.9.1_YouTube_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

YTKACE 0.9.0

**What's new:**
- Updated for YouTube 21.33.6
- Playback Recovery has been rebuilt from scratch
- Default playback speed is now a menu with Follow YouTube, Match last used, and Custom
- Japanese is now selectable in the language list
- Added an Audit section to the README covering what was checked and what was found

**Fixed:**
- Fixed SponsorBlock markers jumping to the top of the screen after switching in or out of fullscreen
- Added missing playback speed strings to every non-English language, and translated the settings description that had only ever appeared in English
